messages.content: 一個1公斤的冰塊在0°C被加熱到100°C，在1大氣壓下，其熵變化為多少焦耳/開氏度？

function.name: entropy_change_calculate
function.description: Calculate the change in entropy for a mass of a specific substance under set initial and final conditions. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

substance.description: The substance for which the change in entropy is calculated.

mass.description: The mass of the substance in kg.

initial_temperature.description: The initial temperature of the substance in degree Celsius.

final_temperature.description: The final temperature of the substance in degree Celsius.

pressure.description: The pressure the substance is under in atmospheres.

message.content:
**熵變化計算（1 kg 冰 → 100 °C 水，1 atm）**

| 步驟 | 變化 | 熵變化公式 | 計算結果 |
|------|------|------------|----------|
| 1. **熔化**（0 °C → 0 °C） | \( \Delta S_{\text{fus}} = \dfrac{m\,L_f}{T_m}\) | \( \Delta S_{\text{fus}} = \dfrac{1\;\text{kg}\times 334\,000\;\text{J/kg}}{273.15\;\text{K}}\) | **≈ 1223 J/K** |
| 2. **加熱水**（0 °C → 100 °C） | \( \Delta S_{\text{heat}} = m\,C_{p,w}\,\ln\!\left(\dfrac{T_f}{T_i}\right)\) | \( \Delta S_{\text{heat}} = 1\;\text{kg}\times 4184\;\text{J/(kg·K)}\times \ln\!\left(\dfrac{373.15}{273.15}\right)\) | **≈ 1307 J/K** |

**總熵變化**

\[
\boxed{\Delta S_{\text{total}} = \Delta S_{\text{fus}} + \Delta S_{\text{heat}}
      \approx 1223\;\text{J/K} + 1307\;\text{J/K}
      \approx 2530\;\text{J/K}}
\]

> **答案：** 約 **\(2.53\times10^3\) J/K**（即 2.53 kJ/K）。  

> （若最終狀態是蒸汽，還需再加入蒸發階段的熵變化，總值約 8.58 kJ/K。）

1) Melting at 0°C: ΔS_melt = m * L_f / T_m, where L_f is latent heat of fusion per kg (~334 kJ/kg). T_m = 273.15 K.

2) Heating water from 0°C to 100°C: ΔS_heat_water = m * ∫ C_p_water dT / T. For water, Cp ~ 4184 J/(kg·K). For small range, approximate constant. Then ΔS = m * Cp * ln(T_final/T_initial). T_initial=273.15 K, T_final=373.15 K.

ΔS_melt = 334000 J/kg / 273.15 K = 1222.5 J/K.

ΔS_heat_water = 4184 * ln(373.15/273.15) = 4184 * ln(1.366) = 4184 * 0.312 = 1307 J/K.

Total ΔS = 1222.5 + 1307 = 2529.5 J/K.
